key_insight: Pretrained MobileNet with differential attention achieved the highest slide-level AUC (0.862), while adding spatial attention to channel attention showed no detectable benefit.
clinical_relevance: This study evaluates AI-assisted distinction of high- versus low-grade serous ovarian carcinoma, not drug discovery, and does not establish readiness for clinical use.
method: Compared CNN attention variants, pretrained MobileNet, and a Phikon foundation-model benchmark.
Used stain normalization, slide-level pooling, and five-fold slide-grouped cross-validation.
Evaluated three training seeds with within-fold threshold selection and multiplicity-corrected statistical comparisons.
evidence_signal: On 259 UBC-OCEAN slides (217 high-grade, 42 low-grade), pretrained MobileNet achieved AUC 0.862 ± 0.005 and MCC 0.460, significantly outperforming the no-attention baseline.
watch_item: Class imbalance, a single-cohort evaluation, and colour-only AUC of 0.66 warrant independent validation and scrutiny of stain-related confounding.
paper_title: Which Attention Helps? A Slide-Level Ablation of Attention-Augmented CNNs for Serous Ovarian Carcinoma Grading
